frame: docs/design/rulings-2026-10-23d.md (the daze, the sell and the rally; behind rally.enabled)

links.name: Crane Reel
links.input: RB with A at the body in flight
links.what: the crane hook latches the body's arms or torso mid-flight; his payoff, the throw, reels it back toward him on the cable and turns it once, short and at body height (never overhead), then flings it 6 bh along the stick: the flight reversed
links.tech: item 8 with 23d item 17's middle step: 4 ticks for a fresh kind, 6 for a kind used earlier in the rally but not as the last link, 8 for the same kind as the last, and a third of one kind is teched by itself
links.tell: the hook swings once behind him
links.look: the cable snaps taut, the winch screams, the body comes back and goes round
links.legal: the hook binds arms or torso, the held fighter struggles; the swing is a short turn at body height, never overhead (Legal RL-183); one call-out (ln06); no taunt over the reel

links.name: Wreck Toss
links.input: two presses, each one action: the pick-up (A), then the throw (Y) at the body in flight. He must be free (not inside a zip), the body out of striking reach (a rally gives that), and the wreck within 2 bh, inside his tier's lift, empty, with nothing living near it
links.what: he hurls the wreck at the flying body; it strikes and sends the body on along the throw's line, as a thrown object does, and bursts into scrap, which damages structures by the tier factor. The lift's tell takes its time while the body flies on, so the throw must arrive while the body is still in flight or within the 20 ticks after it lands (23d item 11); otherwise the rally has already ended
links.price: none: throwables carry no ki (23d item 20)
links.tech: item 8 with 23d item 17's middle step: 4 ticks for a fresh kind, 6 for a kind used earlier in the rally but not as the last link, 8 for the same kind as the last, and a third of one kind is teched by itself
links.tell: the lift: a forearm plate under the frame
links.look: a wreck tumbling end over end into the body and bursting into scrap
links.legal: wrecks are always empty and nothing living is near: a wreck with a person near it is not a candidate (Legal RL-183); wreckage and metal only; Legal RL-186: the pick-up is refused with any civilian within 3 bh of the wreck, indoors or out, and the link is never chosen for a landing near people
links._ruled: 23d item 20: allowed, as a world link in two presses

lift._ruled: Game Design 2026-10-26 item 3: the heaviest wreck each tier lifts is [2, 6, 16, 57] on World's wreck masses
lift._unit: World's wreck mass, the graspable piece in cubic body heights
lift._check: Checked by Combat against the throwables table (rule-of-cool.md: tier 1 lifts mass 4, a van; tier 2 mass 8, a bus; tier 3 ships). The two tables use different units: the cars' masses are Art's classes (bike 1, sedan 3, van 4, bus 8), and a wreck's mass is its graspable piece in cubic body heights (World, wreck-toss.md, fill 0.012). Read as one scale they fight at tiers 1 and 2 (a tier-1 fighter would lift a mass-4 van but not a mass-3 wreck). In heft they agree: the cars' boxes are 0.24, 2.04, 3.45 and 15.08 cubic bh (bike, sedan, van, bus), so a solid wreck piece of 2 at tier 1 sits near a hollow van, 6 at tier 2 near a hollow bus, and 16 and 57 sit in the ship range. Recommended: World names its field wreckMass (cubic bh), so nobody compares it with the car classes as one scale

links._body: what the hit does to a body stays the throwables' rule, damage by size; the burst's damage to structures is World's brunt ladder with the tier factor

links.name: Slag Catch
links.input: RB with Y held to level 2, its landing led to where the body will come down
links.what: the slag lands and rolls to the landing; the body comes down in it and the burst pops it 3 bh back up, so the rally goes on even on soft ground where a spike would end it
links.tech: item 8 with 23d item 17's middle step: 4 ticks for a fresh kind, 6 for a kind used earlier in the rally but not as the last link, 8 for the same kind as the last, and a third of one kind is teched by itself
links.tell: he hammers his chest plate, the grille steps bright
links.look: a glassy track of rolling slag, a burst under the falling body
links.legal: the burst is one flash event; the slag rolls, it never seeks people

sell._frame: 23d item 4 as Game Design re-read it (2026-10-26 item 18): the sold blows are Y mediums, each played a size larger with the launch's hit-stop (12) and a camera push; B's send ends the sell as its heaviest blow, with the decisive hit-stop (20); lights aren't sold. Two mediums, then the send. The sell is the look, never the number

medium.head: the sensor housing jerks aside and its lights stutter under a 10% step
medium.body: plates dent with a clang and spring back
medium.recover: the seams hiss as the flesh beneath knits

medium2.head: snapped back, sparks from the neck seams (one burst)
medium2.body: folds at the waist joint, the chest grille rattling, driven a step back
medium2.recover: a whirr as the limiter resets; the flesh steams and closes

sell._medium2: the second sold medium, a step bigger than the first

send.look: launched in a shower of loose rivets and wire, limbs swinging on their joints
send._send: B's send: the heaviest blow of the sell, the decisive hit-stop (20)

sell.voice: a mechanical grind and a growl; the hunger lines stay in his voice, never in a mouth
sell._legal: the body is never limp; no slow motion beyond the hit-stop, no taunt over a dazed fighter; each sold blow is one flash event at most (fx08)

legalAsks: the crane reel in the air
his sell's flicker and sparks under fx08
_flash: Legal mc04: the flash cap of 3 counted bursts a second holds across the whole rally; a link whose flash would pass it draws as dust, trail and ember instead
_ownKind: ruled (23d item 17): each own link is its own kind for item 8's grip and item 13's scoring
